column5: 100% of the 2,496 virtual schools have a reserved seclusion code (mostly -9), so they are all excluded from the analysis-ready file and virtual vs non-virtual seclusion cannot be compared. column5: enr_504 is 22.6% missing and enr_el 18.8% (vs under 0.3% in 2017-18); missingness is concentrated by state (IA, PR, SD, NM, MT for 504; MT, PR, WV, SD, VT for EL).
